# wanaku.ai

> Wanaku is a governed action proxy for AI agents. It sits between agents and the systems they act on, intercepting tool calls, agent-to-agent messages, and inference traffic. Policy, identity, data controls, and audit happen in the proxy — agents never touch backend systems directly.

Important notes:
- Wanaku started as an MCP Router and has expanded its scope to govern all agent actions.
- Integration developers build Apache Camel routes and publish them as tools; agents call those tools with parameters, but Wanaku runs the actual work.
- Wanaku Barn is the Java/Quarkus-based platform built on [Apache Camel](https://camel.apache.org), offering mature enterprise integrations.

The project name comes from the origins of the word [Guanaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guanaco), a camelid native to
South America.

## Core Content
- [Documentation](https://wanaku.ai/docs/): Guides, API reference, demos, and SDK docs
- [Project Organization](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/): GitHub organization with all Wanaku repositories
- [Wanaku](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku): Source code for Wanaku
- [Wanaku Barn](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku-barn): Source code for the Java/Quarkus-based Wanaku Barn
- [Wanaku Releases](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku/releases): Wanaku releases for download
- [Project Examples](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku-examples): Example configurations and integrations
